correctness.rationale: Let A=[[a,b],[0,c]]. For an idempotent E=[[e,x],[0,f]], e,f are 0 or 1 and (e+f−1)x=0. Diagonal types 00 and 11 contribute respectively if a,c≠0 or a,c≠1. Types 10,01 have unrestricted x and commute with A iff (a−c)x=±b, giving exactly mu(A)=1 when a≠c, q when a=c,b=0, 0 otherwise, subject to respective diagonal-unit tests. This proves stated exact s(A) formula for every finite field; partition into diagonals in {0,1}, a=c=λ outside, and distinct outside gives q=2 all 8 unique and for q>2 fiber counts s=1:4q; s=2:(q−2)(5q−1); s=4:q(q−2)(q−3); s=2q+2:q−2, sum q^3. New brute force enumerates all A,E in F2,F3,F5,F7 with direct matrix products, verifies elementwise formula and histograms. Proof uses only field properties, so prime-power generality does not depend on tested prime fields.
